title: fastpath: add gating, precision-toggle and safe-mode fallback for correctness/perf tradeoffs
author: Maya Patel
description:
Motivation: the fast-path kernel selector provides significant latency wins for common model/hardware/precision combos, but we've observed rare correctness regressions when combined with aggressive quantization and certain KV-cache eviction schedules. This PR implements a conservative fast-path gating mechanism, a runtime precision-toggle, and a safe-mode fallback that prioritizes correctness over micro-latency when triggered.

What this changes: 1) fastpath gating: a policy layer that evaluates per-request and per-model predicates (sequence length, quantization profile, kernel compatibility matrix, recent fastpath error rates) before allowing the low-latency kernel to run. 2) precision-toggle: a lightweight runtime flag that allows toggling computation precision (fp16/bf16/int8 emulation) at the request or model policy level; used to repro and mitigate precision-induced regressions. 3) safe-mode fallback: when the fastpath execution indicates a checksum/consistency anomaly (KV mismatch, generation divergence, or internal kernel assert), the request is transparently retried on the safe-path with stricter kernels and higher-precision execution. Retries are rate-limited and instrumented to avoid cascading cost increases.

Implementation notes: - Kernel selector changes (runtime/kernel_selector.rs): introduces PolicyEvaluator and compatibility matrix lookup; smallest-impact checks are evaluated first to avoid perf regressions. - Fastpath gating config (config/fastpath_policy.rs): new schema supports per-model overrides, rollout percentage, and a fallthrough default. - Precision toggle plumbing (runtime/precision.rs): per-request override + model default resolution, exposed on internal request metadata. - Safe-mode fallback (runtime/safe_fallback.rs): lightweight retry path that preserves token-level KV cache state on retry where possible; falls back to a full safe execution when KV state cannot be reconciled. - Continuous batching adjustments (runtime/batching.rs): ensure batching aligns with safe-mode retry semantics to avoid duplicate outputs and to maintain ordering. - KV cache fixes (runtime/kv_cache.rs): edge-case race with concurrent eviction when a request is retried; added a compare-and-restore flow to preserve cache invariants. - Telemetry: new metrics fastpath.allowed, fastpath.blocked_reason, fastpath.safe_retries, fastpath.precision_overrides; added histograms for approximation delta when safe-mode triggers.

Testing and validation: - Unit tests for PolicyEvaluator and precision resolution. - Integration tests that induce KV mismatch and assert transparent safe-mode retry behavior. - Perf bench harness updated to measure median p50/p95 with fastpath on/off and with safe-mode enabled; results included in commits. - Staged rollout: default gating is off for stable models, enabled at 10% for canary models; can be toggled via remote feature flag.

Rollout and operational considerations: - Metrics and alerts: added SLO alert for fastpath.safe_retries > 1% sustained. - Cost telemetry to monitor retry overhead. - Suggested gradual rollout plan in PR body; ops playbook for disabling fastpath per-model.

Related: ENG-4521 (fastpath correctness incidents), ENG-4587 (kv-cache race investigation).

release_notes: Added fastpath gating and safe-mode fallback to protect correctness while maintaining performance. New precision-toggle allows per-request/model overrides. Metrics and alerts added to monitor retries and blocked fastpath evaluations.
backwards_compatibility_notes: All changes are runtime-configurable and default to current behavior for stable models. No API surface changes. Admins can disable fastpath gating via feature flag if unexpected behavior is observed.
